description: This file is a shell script for testing concurrent git svn dcommit operations, including setup of SVN repositories, hooks, and various test cases for conflict handling and rebase behavior.

methods.name: next_N
methods.description: Increments the counter variable N by 1.

methods.name: setup_hook
methods.description: Sets up SVN hooks (pre-commit or post-commit) to simulate failures or concurrent commits.

methods.name: check_contents
methods.description: Checks that the local files and SVN repository are synchronized.

methods.name: delete_first_line
methods.description: Removes the first line from a specified file.
